name: Jev router
tagline: Fast yes-no and scoring calls, so the big model only runs when it earns it.
description: A small, quick classification layer built on the Jev harness. It answers the cheap, constant questions in a pipeline: which branch an item goes down, how urgent it is, which label fits, and where it lands on a rubric. Calibration matters as much as speed, so a pricier model only runs when the question deserves it.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
